generators.name: random protein mutation
generators.description: Propose random amino-acid mutations on a de novo monomer sequence using codon-scheme-biased sampling.

evidence.quote: Design sequences that assemble into Cn-symmetric ring multimers.

constraints.name: protein symmetry ring
constraints.description: Require ESMFold-predicted oligomer to form a symmetric ring with low inter-protomer distance variance.

evidence.quote: Constraints: protein-symmetry-ring, protein-globularity, structure-radius-gyration, structure-composite, overall-protein-quality

constraints.name: protein globularity
constraints.description: Encourage compact, globular monomer folds before oligomer assembly.

constraints.name: structure radius of gyration
constraints.description: Penalize extended monomer structures inconsistent with ring protomers.

constraints.name: structure composite quality
constraints.description: Score oligomer structure confidence with a composite of pLDDT, ipTM, pTM, and PAE from one prediction call.

constraints.name: overall protein quality
constraints.description: Composite developability checks on the monomer sequence (complexity and amino-acid balance).

optimizers.name: pool propose-score-select
optimizers.description: Generate a pool of rejection-sampled ring monomer candidates and select the top-scoring design.

model_dependencies.name: ESMFold
model_dependencies.purpose: Multimer symmetry, globularity, radius-of-gyration, and composite structure scoring

steps.operation: random protein mutation proposals on monomer sequence
ESMFold symmetry ring, globularity, Rg, and composite scoring
rejection sampling on lowest-energy monomer designs
pool propose-score-select over n_pool independent rejection runs

assumptions: Smoke tier uses C3 symmetry (symmetry_order=3) with n_pool=100 for fast GPU sanity checks.
Full tier uses C6 symmetry with n_pool=1000 matching the propose-score-select population search topology.
Each pool member runs an inner rejection-sampling program with ESMFold-backed structure constraints.
Homo-oligomer ring design reuses the same monomer sequence for all protomer chains in symmetry scoring.
unknowns: No canonical paper anchors this v1 fixture; parameters follow internal CANDIDATE_WORKFLOWS spec.
ProteinMPNN structure-conditioned design is deferred; v1 uses random-protein mutation only.
